blocks.zh: 附錄 S1–S6：特殊主題（ASTM E2500 對應 / 電子生產記錄 / 試算表驗證 / 補丁管理 / 組織變更）
blocks.en: Appendices S1–S6: Special Topics (ASTM E2500 Alignment / Electronic Production Records / Spreadsheet Validation / Patch Management / Organizational Change)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Explain how GAMP 5 aligns with and differs from ASTM E2500, and determine when each framework is the appropriate tool. ／ 說明 GAMP 5 與 ASTM E2500 的共同原則與適用場景差異。
blocks.en: Explain how GAMP 5 aligns with and differs from ASTM E2500, and determine when each framework is the appropriate tool.

blocks.zh: Describe the structure and regulatory requirements of Electronic Production Records (EPR / eBR / eDHR) including audit trail obligations under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11. ／ 描述電子生產記錄的架構、稽核軌跡要求，以及相關法規義務。
blocks.en: Describe the structure and regulatory requirements of Electronic Production Records (EPR / eBR / eDHR) including audit trail obligations under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11.

blocks.zh: Categorize end user applications (spreadsheets, databases, macros) by GAMP category and apply appropriate risk-based validation controls. ／ 依 GAMP 類別分類終端使用者應用程式，套用風險導向驗證控制措施。
blocks.en: Categorize end user applications (spreadsheets, databases, macros) by GAMP category and apply appropriate risk-based validation controls.

blocks.zh: Apply a risk-based patch management framework that balances enterprise cybersecurity risk against GxP validated-state maintenance. ／ 建立平衡資安風險與 GxP 驗證狀態的補丁管理決策架構。
blocks.en: Apply a risk-based patch management framework that balances enterprise cybersecurity risk against GxP validated-state maintenance.

blocks.zh: Identify the compliance impacts of organizational change (M&A, outsourcing, supplier loss) on validated computerized systems. ／ 識別組織變更對已驗證電腦化系統的法規合規影響。
blocks.en: Identify the compliance impacts of organizational change (M&A, outsourcing, supplier loss) on validated computerized systems.

blocks.zh: Apply the stakeholder engagement and documentation update requirements for CSV programs undergoing organizational restructuring. ／ 在組織重組期間，執行 CSV 程式的利害關係人參與及文件更新要求。
blocks.en: Apply the stakeholder engagement and documentation update requirements for CSV programs undergoing organizational restructuring.

blocks.zh: Appendix S1 — Alignment with ASTM E2500 (p347–p351) Appendix S1 — 與 ASTM E2500 對齊
blocks.en: Appendix S1 — Alignment with ASTM E2500 (p347–p351)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：GAMP 5 vs. ASTM E2500
blocks.en: Commentary: GAMP 5 vs. ASTM E2500

blocks.zh: 兩個框架的本質差異
blocks.en: The Fundamental Difference Between the Two Frameworks

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500 的核心目標是製造設備與製程系統的規格、設計和驗證（specification, design, and verification）。它是工程導向的，強調把設備的 IQ/OQ 活動整合成一個以病人風險為中心的「verification」流程，大量借用供應商的測試文件。
blocks.en: The core objective of ASTM E2500 is the specification, design and verification of manufacturing equipment and process systems. It is engineering-oriented: it folds equipment IQ/OQ activities into a single patient-risk-centered "verification" process and makes heavy use of supplier test documentation.

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 的範圍更廣：它涵蓋所有電腦化系統，包括製造執行系統、實驗室系統、ERP、臨床數據系統等，不只是製造設備。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 has a broader scope: it covers all computerized systems, including manufacturing execution systems, laboratory systems, ERP and clinical data systems, not just manufacturing equipment.

blocks.zh: 互補關係：ASTM E2500 的思想直接影響了 GAMP 5 的演進——兩者的核心都是「科學+風險導向」，都反對重複且無價值的文件。
blocks.en: Complementary relationship: the thinking behind ASTM E2500 directly influenced the evolution of GAMP 5. Both are built on a "science plus risk-based" approach, and both oppose duplicative, non-value-adding documentation.

blocks.zh: 實際場景比較
blocks.en: Comparison in Practice

blocks.zh: 使用 ASTM E2500 的情境：廠房新建時導入無菌灌裝機（aseptic filling machine）。設備製造商的工廠驗收測試（FAT）、現場驗收測試（SAT）可直接作為 verification 的一部分，不需要再另外跑完整的 IQ/OQ 文件套組。
blocks.en: When to use ASTM E2500: installing an aseptic filling machine in a new facility. The manufacturer's factory acceptance test (FAT) and site acceptance test (SAT) can be used directly as part of verification, without running a separate full IQ/OQ document set.

blocks.zh: 使用 GAMP 5 的情境：同一條灌裝線上的 MES（Manufacturing Execution System）或 SCADA 系統的電腦化系統驗證，屬於 GAMP 5 的主要適用範疇。
blocks.en: When to use GAMP 5: computerized system validation of the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or SCADA system on the same filling line falls squarely within the scope of GAMP 5.

blocks.zh: 重疊區域：整合控制系統（PLC/DCS）通常兩者都適用；此時依公司政策選擇術語即可，關鍵是文件證明 critical-to-quality requirements 已被驗證。
blocks.en: Overlap area: integrated control systems (PLC/DCS) are usually covered by both. In that case, choose the terminology according to company policy; the key is that documentation demonstrates that the critical-to-quality requirements have been verified.

blocks.zh: 查廠重點
blocks.en: Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: 稽核員關注的不是你用哪個術語（IQ/OQ 或 verification），而是：
blocks.en: Auditors are not concerned with which term you use (IQ/OQ or verification); they want to know:

blocks.zh: 你有沒有識別出對病人風險有影響的關鍵要求（critical-to-quality requirements）？
blocks.en: Have you identified the critical requirements that affect patient risk (critical-to-quality requirements)?

blocks.zh: 你有沒有提供充分的文件證據說明這些要求已被驗證？
blocks.en: Have you provided sufficient documented evidence that these requirements have been verified?

blocks.zh: 你有沒有一份計畫（plan）說明你的驗證方法，以及一份報告（report）作為完成的證據？
blocks.en: Do you have a plan describing your verification approach, and a report as evidence of completion?

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境應用
blocks.en: Application in a CDMO Setting

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境，同一台設備可能生產多個客戶的產品。建議在設備層級做一次完整的 GAMP/ASTM E2500 驗證，然後在產品層級的製程驗證（PV）中確認該設備在特定產品條件下的表現。這樣可以避免每換一個產品就重跑完整 IQ/OQ 的資源浪費。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the same piece of equipment may manufacture products for several clients. We recommend performing one full GAMP/ASTM E2500 verification at the equipment level, then confirming the equipment's performance under product-specific conditions during product-level process validation (PV). This avoids the waste of re-running a full IQ/OQ every time the product changes.

blocks.zh: Appendix S2 — Electronic Production Records (EPR / eBR) (p351–p361) Appendix S2 — 電子生產紀錄 (EPR / eBR)
blocks.en: Appendix S2 — Electronic Production Records (EPR / eBR) (p351–p361)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：電子批次記錄 (eBR)
blocks.en: Commentary: Electronic Batch Records (eBR)

blocks.zh: eBR vs. 傳統紙本批次記錄
blocks.en: eBR vs. Traditional Paper Batch Records

blocks.zh: 電子批次記錄（eBR / Electronic Batch Record）是 EPR 的輸出報告形式。GAMP 5 的 ISA-88 術語體系幫助我們理解這個架構：
blocks.en: The electronic batch record (eBR) is the output report form of the EPR. The ISA-88 terminology used in GAMP 5 helps us understand this structure:

blocks.zh: Master Recipe = 你的配方/製程指令（相當於 MBR）
blocks.en: Master Recipe = your recipe / process instructions (equivalent to the MBR)

blocks.zh: Control Recipe = 針對特定批次的 MBR 實例（相當於 Production Batch Record 的指令部分）
blocks.en: Control Recipe = the batch-specific instance of the MBR (equivalent to the instruction part of the Production Batch Record)

blocks.zh: EPR = 執行過程中產生的所有數據（分散在多個系統中）
blocks.en: EPR = all data generated during execution (distributed across multiple systems)

blocks.zh: Batch Report = 彙整給 QA 審查/放行的人類可讀文件（就是我們說的 eBR 或 eDHR）
blocks.en: Batch Report = the human-readable document compiled for QA review and release (what we call the eBR or eDHR)

blocks.zh: 重要區分：EPR 是數據的儲存，Batch Report 是審查用的呈現形式。兩者之間的轉換（report generation）本身需要被驗證。
blocks.en: Important distinction: the EPR is the storage of data, while the Batch Report is the presentation used for review. The conversion between the two (report generation) itself needs to be validated.

blocks.zh: CDMO 導入 eBR 的關鍵挑戰
blocks.en: Key Challenges for a CDMO Implementing eBR

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 為客戶產品導入電子批次記錄時，稽核員特別關注以下問題：
blocks.en: When a CDMO implements electronic batch records for a client's product, auditors pay particular attention to the following questions:

blocks.zh: 數據所有權：批次數據最終歸客戶還是 CDMO？數據遷移或合約終止時如何處理？
blocks.en: Data ownership: does the batch data ultimately belong to the client or to the CDMO? How is it handled upon data migration or contract termination?

blocks.zh: Master Recipe 控管：客戶提供的配方如何安全地匯入 MES？版本控制如何確保？
blocks.en: Master Recipe control: how is a client-supplied recipe imported into the MES securely? How is version control ensured?

blocks.zh: 跨系統完整性：當 ERP、MES、LIMS 各自保存一部分 EPR 數據時，如何確保整份 eBR 的完整性（completeness）？
blocks.en: Cross-system integrity: when the ERP, MES and LIMS each hold part of the EPR data, how do you ensure the completeness of the entire eBR?

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡範圍：所有 GMP 相關操作（修改、刪除、電子簽名）都必須被記錄，且與系統技術日誌明確區分。
blocks.en: Audit trail scope: all GMP-relevant actions (modifications, deletions, electronic signatures) must be recorded and clearly distinguished from the system's technical logs.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11 的核心要求
blocks.en: Core Requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11

blocks.zh: 兩個法規的共同要求核心：
blocks.en: The requirements common to both regulations are:

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）：必須記錄誰、何時、修改了什麼（原值 vs. 新值）
blocks.en: Audit trail: must record who changed what and when (original value vs. new value)

blocks.zh: 電子簽名（Electronic Signature）：與手寫簽名法律效力相同；必須包含姓名、日期時間、簽名意義（例如：審查/批准）
blocks.en: Electronic signature: carries the same legal weight as a handwritten signature; must include the printed name, date and time, and the meaning of the signature (for example, review or approval)

blocks.zh: 記錄保護：記錄必須防止未經授權的修改（access control + audit trail 雙重保護）
blocks.en: Record protection: records must be protected against unauthorized modification (dual protection through access control and audit trail)

blocks.zh: 可讀性與可存取性：在保存期間內必須保持可存取且人類可讀
blocks.en: Readability and accessibility: records must remain accessible and human-readable throughout the retention period

blocks.zh: 稽核員的 483 觀察重點：「Audit trail is not reviewed as part of batch record review.」— 這是最常見的 eBR 系統缺失。
blocks.en: Auditors' typical Form 483 observation: "Audit trail is not reviewed as part of batch record review." This is the most common eBR system deficiency.

blocks.zh: Review by Exception (RBE) — 實際意義
blocks.en: Review by Exception (RBE): What It Means in Practice

blocks.zh: 傳統做法：QA 人員審閱整份批次記錄，包括所有在允差內的製程數據。
blocks.en: Traditional approach: QA personnel review the entire batch record, including all process data that fell within tolerance.

blocks.zh: RBE 做法：系統自動篩選，只把超出規格、需要人工判斷的例外項目呈現給 QA 審查。正常的數據不需要人眼逐一確認。
blocks.en: RBE approach: the system automatically filters the data and presents to QA only the exceptions that are out of specification and need human judgment. Normal data does not need to be checked one by one by eye.

blocks.zh: 好處：大幅提高審查效率；風險：RBE 篩選邏輯本身必須經過嚴格驗證，否則可能遺漏真正的問題。
blocks.en: Benefit: review efficiency improves substantially. Risk: the RBE filtering logic itself must be rigorously validated, otherwise genuine problems may be missed.

blocks.zh: 查廠重點：即使批次完全沒有例外，RBE 報告也必須被產生並由授權人員審核（不能「沒有例外 = 不需要簽名」）。
blocks.en: Inspection focus: even when a batch has no exceptions at all, the RBE report must still be generated and reviewed by authorized personnel ("no exceptions" does not mean "no signature needed").

blocks.zh: Cloud EPR 驗證狀態維護責任
blocks.en: Responsibility for Maintaining the Validated State of a Cloud EPR

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 明確聲明：即使系統部署在雲端，終端使用者（即藥廠）仍對驗證狀態負最終責任。這對使用 SaaS MES 的公司影響深遠：
blocks.en: GAMP 5 states explicitly that even when a system is deployed in the cloud, the end user (that is, the pharmaceutical company) remains ultimately responsible for the validated state. This has far-reaching implications for companies using a SaaS MES:

blocks.zh: 供應商的軟體更新需要評估對驗證狀態的衝擊
blocks.en: Supplier software updates must be assessed for their impact on the validated state

blocks.zh: 必須在供應商合約中明確服務水準協議（SLA）和資料完整性責任
blocks.en: Service level agreements (SLAs) and data integrity responsibilities must be defined clearly in the supplier contract

blocks.zh: 需要建立監控機制，確保雲端系統的可用性符合生產需求
blocks.en: A monitoring mechanism must be established to ensure that cloud system availability meets production needs

blocks.zh: Appendix S3 — End User Applications Including Spreadsheets (p361–p370) Appendix S3 — 終端使用者應用（含試算表）
blocks.en: Appendix S3 — End User Applications Including Spreadsheets (p361–p370)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：試算表驗證
blocks.en: Commentary: Spreadsheet Validation

blocks.zh: FDA 483 最常見觀察項目：未驗證的 Excel 試算表
blocks.en: The Most Common FDA 483 Observation: Unvalidated Excel Spreadsheets

blocks.zh: 這是製藥界最普遍的合規問題之一。常見的 483 觀察文字是：
blocks.en: This is one of the most widespread compliance problems in the pharmaceutical industry. A typical 483 observation reads:

blocks.zh: 問題的根源在於：試算表被視為「日常辦公工具」而非「電腦化系統」，因此沒有納入 CSV 程式管控。
blocks.en: The root cause is that spreadsheets are regarded as "everyday office tools" rather than "computerized systems", so they are not brought under the CSV program.

blocks.zh: GxP 試算表最低文件要求（實務清單）
blocks.en: Minimum Documentation for GxP Spreadsheets (Practical Checklist)

blocks.zh: 根據 GAMP 5 S3 附錄，以下是風險導向的最低文件要求：
blocks.en: Based on GAMP 5 Appendix S3, the following are the risk-based minimum documentation requirements:

blocks.zh: 需求規格（RS）：說明試算表的用途、輸入數據類型、計算目的、輸出格式（通常一頁即可）
blocks.en: Requirements specification (RS): describes the purpose of the spreadsheet, the types of input data, the purpose of the calculations and the output format (usually one page is enough)

blocks.zh: 公式驗證記錄：列出所有儲存格公式（可列印公式視圖），由第三方確認公式邏輯正確
blocks.en: Formula verification record: lists all cell formulas (a printout of the formula view is acceptable), with the formula logic confirmed correct by a second person

blocks.zh: 測試案例：至少包括正常值、邊界值、已知結果的樣本計算
blocks.en: Test cases: at least normal values, boundary values and sample calculations with known results

blocks.zh: 版本控制：版本號、修改日期、修改者、審核者，儲存於安全目錄
blocks.en: Version control: version number, date of change, person who made the change and reviewer, stored in a secure directory

blocks.zh: 存取控制：非輸入欄位應鎖定，防止意外修改
blocks.en: Access control: non-input cells should be locked to prevent accidental modification

blocks.zh: 變更控制程序：任何修改都需要重新驗證並記錄影響評估
blocks.en: Change control procedure: any modification requires revalidation and a documented impact assessment

blocks.zh: Macro（巨集）的特殊風險
blocks.en: Special Risks of Macros

blocks.zh: 許多使用者認為「錄製巨集」只是記錄按鍵動作，不是真正的程式設計。但 GAMP 5 明確指出：即使是錄製的巨集，背後也是 VBA 程式碼。
blocks.en: Many users believe that "recording a macro" merely captures keystrokes and is not real programming. GAMP 5 states clearly, however, that even a recorded macro is VBA code underneath.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: 含有巨集的試算表必須視為 Category 5 軟體
blocks.en: A spreadsheet containing macros must be treated as Category 5 software

blocks.zh: 所有邏輯分支（IF 判斷）都需要測試
blocks.en: All logic branches (IF statements) must be tested

blocks.zh: 巨集碼需要版本控制（不能只控制試算表本身）
blocks.en: The macro code needs version control (not just the spreadsheet itself)

blocks.zh: 如果 VBA 碼使用了外部引用或 API，還需要整合測試
blocks.en: If the VBA code uses external references or APIs, integration testing is also required

blocks.zh: 建議做法：如果業務需求需要複雜巨集，評估是否應直接使用正式驗證過的系統（例如 LIMS、MES）會更安全。
blocks.en: Recommended practice: if a business need calls for complex macros, assess whether it would be safer to use a formally validated system (such as a LIMS or MES) instead.

blocks.zh: 試算表作為資料庫：為何危險
blocks.en: Spreadsheets as Databases: Why This Is Dangerous

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 非常明確地說：需要稽核軌跡的 GxP 資料，不應使用試算表儲存。原因：
blocks.en: GAMP 5 is very clear: GxP data that requires an audit trail should not be stored in a spreadsheet. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: Excel 沒有原生稽核軌跡（Track Changes 功能不符合 GxP 要求）
blocks.en: Excel has no native audit trail (the Track Changes function does not meet GxP requirements)

blocks.zh: 每次儲存都會覆蓋整個檔案，無法追蹤誰改了哪一個儲存格
blocks.en: Every save overwrites the entire file, so there is no way to trace who changed which cell

blocks.zh: 存取控制薄弱，無法有效防止未授權修改
blocks.en: Access control is weak and cannot effectively prevent unauthorized modification

blocks.zh: 如果目前有用 Excel 管理 GxP 資料（例如穩定性數據表、OOS 追蹤表），建議納入風險評估，優先考慮遷移到有原生稽核軌跡的系統。
blocks.en: If Excel is currently used to manage GxP data (for example stability data tables or OOS tracking sheets), include it in a risk assessment and give priority to migrating to a system with a native audit trail.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：QC 計算試算表驗證策略
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Validation Strategy for QC Calculation Spreadsheets

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境，實驗室經常使用 Excel 計算含量均一度、效價、降解物等。建議策略：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, laboratories often use Excel to calculate content uniformity, potency, degradation products and similar results. The recommended strategy is:

blocks.zh: 建立試算表盤點清單（Inventory），依 GxP 影響分類
blocks.en: Build a spreadsheet inventory and classify each entry by GxP impact

blocks.zh: 高影響（產品放行決策相關）→ 正式 RS + 驗證 + 版本控制
blocks.en: High impact (related to product release decisions) → formal RS + validation + version control

blocks.zh: 低影響（研究用輔助計算）→ 文件化說明計算目的即可
blocks.en: Low impact (auxiliary calculations for research use) → documenting the purpose of the calculation is sufficient

blocks.zh: 考慮使用 EDMS 管控所有高影響試算表，確保版本完整性
blocks.en: Consider using an EDMS to control all high-impact spreadsheets, to ensure version integrity

blocks.zh: 定期（例如每年）審查盤點清單，確認沒有未管控的新增試算表
blocks.en: Review the inventory periodically (for example annually) to confirm that no new uncontrolled spreadsheets have appeared

blocks.zh: Appendix S4 — Patch and Update Management (p371–p373) Appendix S4 — 修補程式與更新管理
blocks.en: Appendix S4 — Patch and Update Management (p371–p373)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：補丁管理的兩難困境
blocks.en: Commentary: The Patch Management Dilemma

blocks.zh: 核心衝突：立即打補丁 vs. 先測試
blocks.en: The Core Conflict: Patch Immediately vs. Test First

blocks.zh: 這是許多製藥廠 IT/品保部門的日常矛盾：
blocks.en: This is a daily tension between IT and Quality in many pharmaceutical companies:

blocks.zh: IT 資安立場：Windows/Linux 發布高危漏洞補丁 → 應在 24-48 小時內部署，否則系統暴露在攻擊風險中
blocks.en: IT security position: when Windows or Linux releases a patch for a high-severity vulnerability, it should be deployed within 24-48 hours; otherwise the system is exposed to attack.

blocks.zh: GxP 合規立場：任何對已驗證系統的變更都需要影響評估和測試，怎麼可能 48 小時內完成？
blocks.en: GxP compliance position: any change to a validated system requires impact assessment and testing, so how could that be completed within 48 hours?

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 的答案是：企業資安風險通常優先於 GxP 法規風險。關鍵是要有一個被 QA 批准的程序，規定在不同威脅等級下採取不同策略，並且記錄決策依據。
blocks.en: GAMP 5's answer is: enterprise security risk generally takes precedence over GxP regulatory risk. The key is to have a QA-approved procedure that prescribes different strategies for different threat levels and documents the basis for each decision.

blocks.zh: 實務補丁策略設計
blocks.en: Designing a Practical Patch Strategy

blocks.zh: 建議將補丁分為三類來管理：
blocks.en: We recommend managing patches in three categories:

blocks.zh: 緊急安全補丁（Critical Security）：CVSS 評分 ≥ 9.0 或已有主動攻擊 → 採用 Strategy 1/2，事後補齊測試記錄；通知幫服台和使用者；QA 記錄風險決策
blocks.en: Critical security patches: CVSS score ≥ 9.0 or active exploitation → use Strategy 1/2, with test records completed afterwards; notify the help desk and users; QA documents the risk decision

blocks.zh: 一般安全補丁（High/Medium）：計畫到下個維護窗口，在非 GxP 環境先測試 1-2 週後推送 GxP 系統 → 採用 Strategy 2/3
blocks.en: Routine security patches (High/Medium): schedule for the next maintenance window, test in a non-GxP environment for 1-2 weeks, then push to GxP systems → use Strategy 2/3

blocks.zh: 功能更新 / Service Pack：完整的影響評估 + 回歸測試 + 變更控制 → 採用 Strategy 3/4
blocks.en: Functional updates / Service Packs: full impact assessment + regression testing + change control → use Strategy 3/4

blocks.zh: 查廠重點：補丁管理 SOP 的必備要素
blocks.en: Inspection Focus: Essential Elements of a Patch Management SOP

blocks.zh: 稽核員在檢查補丁管理時會尋找：
blocks.en: When inspecting patch management, auditors look for:

blocks.zh: 是否有 QA 批准的補丁管理 SOP，且涵蓋 GxP 系統
blocks.en: A QA-approved patch management SOP that covers GxP systems

blocks.zh: 每個補丁是否有影響評估記錄（即使決定「不測試」也要記錄理由）
blocks.en: An impact assessment record for every patch (even a decision "not to test" must have its rationale documented)

blocks.zh: 配置管理記錄是否能顯示「某系統在某日期的補丁水準」
blocks.en: Configuration management records that can show the patch level of a system on a given date

blocks.zh: 緊急補丁後是否有「補後測試」記錄（retrospective testing documentation）
blocks.en: Retrospective testing documentation after an emergency patch

blocks.zh: 跨站點系統是否維持相同補丁水準（interoperability 問題）
blocks.en: Whether systems spanning multiple sites maintain the same patch level (interoperability issue)

blocks.zh: 組態管理記錄的實際重要性
blocks.en: Why Configuration Management Records Matter in Practice

blocks.zh: 當生產系統發生資料異常或系統故障時，調查的第一步通常是查詢「事件發生時系統的確切版本和補丁水準」。如果組態管理記錄不完整，就無法確定是否因為某個補丁引入了問題，也無法向稽核員證明系統在事件前後的配置狀態。
blocks.en: When a production system shows a data anomaly or failure, the first step of the investigation is usually to look up the exact version and patch level of the system at the time of the event. If configuration management records are incomplete, you cannot determine whether a patch introduced the problem, nor can you show auditors the configuration state of the system before and after the event.

blocks.zh: 建議工具：使用 CMDB（Configuration Management Database）或在變更控制系統中強制記錄每次補丁後的版本快照。
blocks.en: Recommended tooling: use a CMDB (Configuration Management Database), or enforce recording a version snapshot after every patch in the change control system.

blocks.zh: OT/IT 融合環境（SCADA、DCS）的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Special Challenges in Converged OT/IT Environments (SCADA, DCS)

blocks.zh: 生產環境的控制系統（例如無菌灌裝線的 PLC/SCADA）往往有更長的補丁延遲，因為：
blocks.en: Production control systems (for example the PLC/SCADA of an aseptic filling line) often have longer patch delays because:

blocks.zh: 設備供應商（如 Rockwell、Siemens）需要先測試補丁對控制邏輯的影響再發布認可版本
blocks.en: Equipment suppliers (such as Rockwell and Siemens) must first test the patch's impact on the control logic before releasing an approved version

blocks.zh: 生產設備通常 24/7 運行，難以安排停機維護窗口
blocks.en: Production equipment usually runs 24/7, making it hard to schedule maintenance downtime

blocks.zh: 某些老舊設備的作業系統（如 Windows XP embedded）已停止更新
blocks.en: The operating systems of some legacy equipment (such as Windows XP Embedded) are no longer updated

blocks.zh: 對策：針對 OT 環境建立補償控制措施（compensating controls），例如網路隔離（air gap / DMZ）、入侵偵測系統，並在補丁管理 SOP 中明確 OT 環境的特殊處理規則。
blocks.en: Countermeasure: establish compensating controls for the OT environment, such as network isolation (air gap / DMZ) and intrusion detection systems, and state the special handling rules for the OT environment explicitly in the patch management SOP.

blocks.zh: Appendix S5 — Retired (p375) Appendix S5 — 已廢止
blocks.en: Appendix S5 — Retired (p375)

blocks.zh: 附錄 S5 — 已撤銷（Retired）
blocks.en: Appendix S5 — Retired

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 第一版的 S5 附錄涵蓋「外包 IS/IT 環境中的品質管理」。在第二版中，此內容已被撤銷並重新修訂，改名為 Appendix M11。
blocks.en: Appendix S5 of the first edition of GAMP 5 covered "managing quality within an outsourced IS/IT environment". In the second edition, this content has been retired and revised, and renamed Appendix M11.

blocks.zh: 如需查閱 IT 外包的 GxP 合規管理指引，請參閱 Appendix M11。S5 的空缺是刻意保留，以維持附錄編號序列（S1–S6）的連貫性。
blocks.en: For guidance on GxP compliance management of IT outsourcing, refer to Appendix M11. The gap at S5 is intentional, to keep the appendix numbering sequence (S1–S6) continuous.

blocks.zh: Appendix S6 — Organizational Change (p377–p381) Appendix S6 — 組織變更
blocks.en: Appendix S6 — Organizational Change (p377–p381)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：CSV 程式的組織變更管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Organizational Change Management for CSV Programs

blocks.zh: 為什麼組織變更對 CSV 是高風險事件
blocks.en: Why Organizational Change Is a High-Risk Event for CSV

blocks.zh: 已驗證的電腦化系統存在於特定的組織環境中：有特定的系統負責人、SOP 持有人、IT 支援人員、供應商關係管理者。當組織發生重大變更時，這些角色可能在同一時間全部改變，而系統本身（硬體、軟體、配置）可能完全不變——但它的「驗證狀態維護」所依賴的所有人和程序都斷裂了。
blocks.en: A validated computerized system exists within a specific organizational environment: a specific system owner, SOP owners, IT support staff and supplier relationship managers. When a major organizational change occurs, all of these roles may change at the same time, while the system itself (hardware, software, configuration) may remain exactly the same. But all the people and procedures on which maintenance of its validated state depends have been broken.

blocks.zh: IT 部門重組 / 外包的真實挑戰
blocks.en: The Real Challenges of IT Restructuring / Outsourcing

blocks.zh: 想像一個製藥廠決定把 IT 基礎設施外包給第三方 IT 服務商：
blocks.en: Imagine a pharmaceutical company that decides to outsource its IT infrastructure to a third-party IT service provider:

blocks.zh: 原本的內部 IT 團隊（知道 MES 系統的所有歷史決策）離職了
blocks.en: The original in-house IT team (who knew every historical decision about the MES) has left

blocks.zh: 新的外包供應商不了解 GxP 要求，只按照一般 IT SLA 操作
blocks.en: The new outsourcing provider does not understand GxP requirements and operates only according to a general IT SLA

blocks.zh: 系統的補丁管理、備份驗證、存取控制管理現在由不熟悉 GxP 的人執行
blocks.en: Patch management, backup verification and access control administration for the system are now performed by people unfamiliar with GxP

blocks.zh: 這種情況會導致：驗證狀態的逐漸侵蝕（validated state drift）——系統還在跑，但沒有人確保它還在「驗證狀態」下運行。
blocks.en: The result is validated state drift: the system is still running, but no one ensures that it is still operating in a validated state.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在 M&A 情境下的特殊風險
blocks.en: Special Risks for a CDMO in M&A Scenarios

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 被大型藥廠收購，或自己收購其他 CDMO 時，常見的 GxP 風險包括：
blocks.en: When a CDMO is acquired by a large pharmaceutical company, or acquires other CDMOs itself, common GxP risks include:

blocks.zh: 系統整合壓力：IT 急著整合系統（例如統一 ERP），但整合本身就是對已驗證系統的重大變更，需要重新驗證
blocks.en: Pressure to integrate systems: IT is eager to consolidate systems (for example a single ERP), but the integration is itself a major change to validated systems and requires revalidation

blocks.zh: SOP 衝突：兩個組織各自有不同的 CSV SOP，需要決定遵循哪一套，並訓練所有人員
blocks.en: SOP conflicts: the two organizations each have different CSV SOPs; a decision is needed on which set to follow, and all personnel must be trained

blocks.zh: 供應商審計重新啟動：收購後，新的母公司可能有不同的供應商審計要求，需要重新審計所有關鍵系統供應商
blocks.en: Restarting supplier audits: after an acquisition, the new parent company may have different supplier audit requirements, requiring all critical system suppliers to be re-audited

blocks.zh: 記錄保留責任轉移：客戶的批次記錄、驗證文件的保留責任在合約轉移後如何確保連續性？
blocks.en: Transfer of record retention responsibility: how is continuity ensured for the retention of client batch records and validation documents after the contract is transferred?

blocks.zh: 供應商倒閉的緊急應對
blocks.en: Emergency Response to Supplier Failure

blocks.zh: 這是最難預先準備但後果最嚴重的情境。關鍵行動清單：
blocks.en: This is the hardest scenario to prepare for in advance, and the one with the most serious consequences. The key action list:

blocks.zh: 立即啟動業務連續性計畫（如果有的話）
blocks.en: Activate the business continuity plan immediately (if one exists)

blocks.zh: 執行軟體源碼托管（Escrow）協議：如果合約中有 source code escrow 條款，立即申請釋出
blocks.en: Invoke the software source code escrow agreement: if the contract contains a source code escrow clause, apply for release immediately

blocks.zh: 下載所有支援文件：技術手冊、驗證文件、系統配置記錄——供應商的伺服器可能隨時關閉
blocks.en: Download all supporting documentation: technical manuals, validation documents and system configuration records, because the supplier's servers may be shut down at any time

blocks.zh: 評估現有維護合約：年度維護費已付但供應商倒閉，這是法律問題也是合規問題
blocks.en: Evaluate existing maintenance contracts: the annual maintenance fee has been paid but the supplier has gone bankrupt; this is a legal issue as well as a compliance issue

blocks.zh: 決定替換或維持策略：如果系統還要繼續使用，需要找有能力維護該系統的第三方廠商
blocks.en: Decide on a replace-or-maintain strategy: if the system is to remain in use, find a third-party vendor capable of maintaining it

blocks.zh: 組織變更的 CSV 影響評估框架
blocks.en: CSV Impact Assessment Framework for Organizational Change

blocks.zh: 建議在任何重大組織變更發生時，執行以下 CSV 影響評估：
blocks.en: We recommend carrying out the following CSV impact assessment whenever a major organizational change occurs:

blocks.zh: 盤點清單：列出所有受影響的 GxP 電腦化系統，標記其 GxP 影響等級
blocks.en: Inventory: list all affected GxP computerized systems and mark their GxP impact level

blocks.zh: 角色責任重新對應：系統負責人、SOP 持有人、IT 聯絡人在新組織結構下由誰負責？
blocks.en: Re-mapping of roles and responsibilities: who will be responsible for the system owner, SOP owner and IT contact roles under the new organizational structure?

blocks.zh: 程序文件審查：涉及組織架構、人員職責的 SOP 是否需要更新？
blocks.en: Procedure review: do SOPs that involve organizational structure or personnel responsibilities need to be updated?

blocks.zh: 訓練需求評估：新的負責人員是否已接受系統特定訓練？
blocks.en: Training needs assessment: have the new responsible personnel received system-specific training?

blocks.zh: 合約審查：系統支援合約、許可協議在組織變更後是否仍有效？
blocks.en: Contract review: are system support contracts and license agreements still valid after the organizational change?

blocks.zh: 過渡期監控強化：在組織過渡期間，提高事件監控頻率，設立快速升級機制
blocks.en: Enhanced monitoring during the transition: during the organizational transition, increase the frequency of event monitoring and set up a rapid escalation mechanism

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 章節總結：附錄 S1–S6 核心要點
blocks.en: Section Summary: Key Points of Appendices S1–S6

blocks.zh: S1 — ASTM E2500: GAMP 5 and ASTM E2500 share the same science- and risk-based philosophy. ASTM E2500 focuses on manufacturing equipment; GAMP 5 covers all computerized systems. "Verification" replaces separate IQ/OQ as an integrated activity; the key requirement is evidence that critical-to-quality requirements have been met. ／ 兩者核心一致：以病人風險為中心、借用供應商測試、減少重複活動。術語可以不同，但文件證據必須充分。
blocks.en: S1 — ASTM E2500: GAMP 5 and ASTM E2500 share the same science- and risk-based philosophy. ASTM E2500 focuses on manufacturing equipment; GAMP 5 covers all computerized systems. "Verification" replaces separate IQ/OQ as an integrated activity; the key requirement is evidence that critical-to-quality requirements have been met. The core of both is the same: a patient-risk-centered approach, leveraging supplier testing and reducing duplicated activities. The terminology may differ, but the documented evidence must be sufficient.

blocks.zh: S2 — Electronic Production Records: EPR ≠ Batch Report — EPR is distributed data; the batch report is the human-readable output. Data audit trails are mandatory; they must be reviewed as part of the batch review process. The end user is always ultimately responsible for validated state, even for cloud-hosted systems. ／ 稽核軌跡必須作為批次記錄審查的一部分；RBE 是合規的，但篩選邏輯本身需要被驗證。
blocks.en: S2 — Electronic Production Records: EPR ≠ Batch Report — EPR is distributed data; the batch report is the human-readable output. Data audit trails are mandatory; they must be reviewed as part of the batch review process. The end user is always ultimately responsible for validated state, even for cloud-hosted systems. The audit trail must be reviewed as part of batch record review; RBE is compliant, but its filtering logic itself must be validated.

blocks.zh: S3 — Spreadsheets: Unvalidated GxP spreadsheets are a top FDA 483 observation. Minimum requirements: formula verification, version control, access control, change control. Macros = Category 5 software. Spreadsheets with audit trail requirements should be replaced with proper database systems. ／ Excel 不是 GxP 的安全選項，除非有完整的驗證和控制措施。含巨集的試算表等同 Category 5 軟體。
blocks.en: S3 — Spreadsheets: Unvalidated GxP spreadsheets are a top FDA 483 observation. Minimum requirements: formula verification, version control, access control, change control. Macros = Category 5 software. Spreadsheets with audit trail requirements should be replaced with proper database systems. Excel is not a safe option for GxP unless it has full validation and controls; a spreadsheet containing macros is equivalent to Category 5 software.

blocks.zh: S4 — Patch Management: Enterprise security risk generally takes precedence over GxP risk. Quality unit approves the patch management process but not individual patch decisions. A documented risk-based decision for each patch — including the choice of strategy and testing scope — is required. Configuration records must show patch levels at any point in time. ／ 有「QA 批准程序 + 風險記錄」才能合規地快速打補丁。
blocks.en: S4 — Patch Management: Enterprise security risk generally takes precedence over GxP risk. Quality unit approves the patch management process but not individual patch decisions. A documented risk-based decision for each patch — including the choice of strategy and testing scope — is required. Configuration records must show patch levels at any point in time. Only a QA-approved procedure plus risk records allows patches to be applied quickly while remaining compliant.

blocks.zh: S5 — Retired: Content from GAMP 5 1st Edition S5 (Managing Quality within an Outsourced IS/IT Environment) has been moved to Appendix M11 in the 2nd Edition. ／ 相關內容已移至 Appendix M11。
blocks.en: S5 — Retired: Content from GAMP 5 1st Edition S5 (Managing Quality within an Outsourced IS/IT Environment) has been moved to Appendix M11 in the 2nd Edition. The related content has been moved to Appendix M11.

blocks.zh: S6 — Organizational Change: M&A, outsourcing, and supplier loss all threaten validated state. A CSV-specific organizational change impact assessment is essential. Training requirements must be re-evaluated. Stakeholders from Business, QA, Legal, IT, and Finance must all be engaged. ／ 組織變更不只是 HR 的事——它直接威脅已驗證系統的合規狀態，需要 QA 主動介入管理。
blocks.en: S6 — Organizational Change: M&A, outsourcing, and supplier loss all threaten validated state. A CSV-specific organizational change impact assessment is essential. Training requirements must be re-evaluated. Stakeholders from Business, QA, Legal, IT, and Finance must all be engaged. Organizational change is not just an HR matter: it directly threatens the compliance status of validated systems and requires proactive QA involvement.
